dataset.name: CrowdHuman validation set
dataset.test_note: 250 of the 3370 test photos were not run (the laptop was overloaded and restarted); the scores use the other 3120. The split itself is unchanged.

rules.threshold: F1-optimal at IoU 0.5 on the tune split
rules.speed_note: Speed was not measured, to keep the laptop free, so the speed rule could not be applied; published edge figures are quoted instead.
rules.macro_f1: mean F1 over the levels that occur in the truth

winner.label: Hybrid: YOLOv5m CrowdHuman, heads below 41, ZIP Nano (NWPU) above

calibration.rule: confidence = clamp(8 / (sqrt(rmse_a^2 + rmse_b^2) / 200 * 100), 0.3, 1), rmse by each half's predicted level
